about: sigelo-carrier/0 frames (design/relay-plan.md §11 "Wire contracts as built"; carrier.mjs header). `frames`: seal `value` as `kind` under `key` on `topic` with `nonce`; the result has `length` bytes and SHA-256 `sha256`, and is `hex` when given (frames of at most 4,096 bytes). Opening it gives `value` back. `refusals`: opening `hex` as kind `read_as` under the generic key on `topic` fails with `error`, the first failing check. `derived`: what the seeds yield, each from the formula beside it.
layout: version 0x01 (1) | kind (1) | 16 zero bytes | counter 1, u32 big-endian (4) | XChaCha20-Poly1305 nonce (24) | ciphertext + tag of pad(JCS(value)); additional data = the 22-byte header ‖ UTF-8 topic; pad: 0x80 then 0x00 to the next multiple of 256

kinds.1: invite answer (sigelo-invite/0), on the answer topic, key invite.key
kinds.2: invite reply, on the reply topic, key invite.key
kinds.4: contact notice {bundle: the chain, proof: {body: {v, typ: "contact-notice", did: the current DID, pair}, sig}}, on the mailbox topic, key notice_key; a chain that brings a recovery the receiver had not followed burns K there (re_pair)
kinds.5: prekeys {prekeys: a signed sigelo-msg/0 bundle, want: boolean, known: the receiver's current DID as the sender holds it}, on the mailbox topic, key prekeys_key

derived.kem_pk: X-Wing keygen(rng("kem key") 32 bytes): the answer's kem_pk
derived.kem_ct: X-Wing encapsulate(kem_pk, rng("kem ct") 64 bytes): the reply's kem_ct

K.formula: HKDF-SHA256(secret ‖ shared, salt "sigelo-pair/0", info = the two original DIDs sorted and concatenated, 32)

mailbox.formula: "m/" + hex(HKDF-SHA256(K, salt "sigelo-topic/0", info = B0 ‖ "\n" ‖ A0 ‖ "\n" ‖ week, 16))

prekeys_key.formula: HKDF-SHA256(K, salt "sigelo-prekeys/0", info = sender original DID ‖ "\n" ‖ recipient original DID, 32)

notice_key.formula: HKDF-SHA256(K, salt "sigelo-notice/0", info = sender original DID ‖ "\n" ‖ recipient original DID, 32)

derived.prekey_bundles: per one-time key: id = 16 bytes of the rng, then X-Wing keygen of the next 32; twenty, then the last-resort key alike; rng("alice prekeys") at t0 + 20, rng("bob prekeys") at t0 + 40; exp = iat + 31 days
derived.nonces: frame nonce = rng("nonce " + case) 24 bytes; the generic frames and the refusals use the nonce 0x01 … 0x18
